payload.text: The push of main to local and upstream alone (hv, decision 117). No release rides on it: there is one, 3.3.0 (hv directive 1, decision 109). HELD UNTIL four things: hv has run the one-message rewrite of c1d7d163d, with every seat held and the tree clean, since hv ruled a client's name confidential in Intent's public record (the command and its dry run are in decision 117); a build all at the HEAD to be pushed has passed on devbin-vc's desk, with every seat holding its commits; a Linux preflight at that HEAD has passed on kovacs; and vc has given devbin-vc the word naming that HEAD (decision 90). It carries everything on main since v3.2.8.
